[[Glint]], known as ''Keeper of the [[Flameseeker Prophecies]]'', ''Protector of the [[Forgotten]]'', ''Foe of the [[Undead Lich|Lich Lord]]'', and ''Downfall of the [[Titan]]s'', is an ancient [[dragon]] prophet living within a single grain of sand in the [[Crystal Desert]]. She was said to have been the first creature on [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]], sent here by the [[Gods of Tyria|Gods]] over 3,000 years ago to act as the world's guardian during its shaping, and was later given servants—the Forgotten—to aid her in this task.

In 272 <small>[[Mouvelian calendar|AE]]</small>, Glint compiled the Flameseeker Prophecies, which did not come to fruition until very recently, in 1072 <small>AE</small>. Her role was to welcome the young heroes of Tyria, hailing them as the [[Chosen]] who would destroy the Titans and save the world. After the demise of [[Vizier Khilbron]], she appears as a [[Vision of Glint|vision]] to the heroes, congratulating them and warning them to escape while they can. Just before the volcano at [[Abaddon's Mouth (outpost)|Abaddon's Mouth]] erupts, she seems to spirit away the [[Scepter of Orr]] from the defeated Vizier's hand. She then tasks the heroes with defeating the Titan menace released upon the world by the Vizier's actions.

Glint's lair is filled with eggs — some of which the young heroes may attempt to steal during the bonus of [[The Dragon's Lair]], much to Glint's annoyance — and by 1078 <small>AE</small>, at least [[Baby Dragon|one of these]] has hatched. The [[Destroyer]]s seem determined to kill her offspring, and her loyal servants, the [[dwarf|Dwarven]] [[Brotherhood of the Dragon]], have come to its defence.

==Notes==

* [[Glint's shrine]] is located in [[Droknar's Forge]]. The [[Vision of Glint]] can be summoned by kneeling in front of this shrine to receive guidance from the oracle and to receive the [[Titan quest]]s.
* A [[Statue of Glint]] can be found in the [[Salt Flats]].
* She can not be [[Knock down|knocked down]].
* Glint has 6200 health in Hard Mode.
